PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "Users"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "User"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          AT_ATTR "@subject"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          INTERP_STRING_EXPR
            STRING_OPEN "\""
            STRING_TEXT "user/"
            INTERPOLATION
              INTERP_OPEN "{"
              POSTFIX_EXPR
                LITERAL_EXPR
                  IDENT "User"
                DOT "."
                IDENT "id"
              ERROR
            STRING_CLOSE "\""
